decisions.title: One fact plane; extractors produce facts; rules query facts
decisions.evidence: a:D03,D06,D19 b:D9,D11 c:D05,D16 — all three derivations

justificationTest.statedRequirement: Users need many questions over one codebase; re-parsing per question does not scale and yields inconsistent answers.

decisions.a1Note: Amended per B-ADJ-02: multi-set forcing not uniformly FORCED.

decisions.title: Analysis pins an immutable input snapshot
decisions.evidence: a:D02 b:D4 c:D02 — all three; A3 undercounted as 'only a' for weak corroboration

justificationTest.statedRequirement: A result must be checkable later against what it examined; a mutable input makes that impossible.

decisions.a1Note: Upgrade from A3 CORROBORATED-WEAK: b and c both pin snapshot/content hashes.

decisions.title: Analysis is deterministic given declared inputs
decisions.evidence: a:D01,D26 b:D6 c:D03 — all three

justificationTest.statedRequirement: Determinism is the credibility of a gateable claim; a non-reproducible verdict cannot gate a merge.

decisions.title: Coverage/completeness is first-class; absence ≠ could-not-look
decisions.evidence: a:D05,D06 b:D5,D20 c:D06,D07 — all three

justificationTest.statedRequirement: 'Found nothing' and 'could not look' have opposite meanings for a gate.

decisions.title: Policy (severity/enablement/gating) separate from detection
decisions.evidence: a:D15 b:D30 c:D05,D24 — present in all three but often as preferred packaging not sole forced shape

justificationTest.statedRequirement: A team must set thresholds and enablement without editing detection logic.

decisions.a1Note: Keep DOWNGRADED: agreement exists but not uniformly FORCED across 3/3 as necessity of the exact split.

decisions.title: Stable finding identity enabling net-new gates
decisions.evidence: a:D07,D08,D36 b:D3,D16 c:D14 — all three

justificationTest.statedRequirement: Gating only on new findings requires identity stable across edits that move or reword.

decisions.title: Addressable run/assessment record binds inputs to conclusions
decisions.evidence: a:D27 b:D12,D14 c:D01 — all three

justificationTest.statedRequirement: A checkable result requires one addressable record binding inputs to conclusions.

decisions.title: Shared reference/reachability substrate rather than per-tool graphs
decisions.evidence: a strong (D03,D20); b/c weaker explicit 'one graph' — more fact+evidence than graph product

justificationTest.statedRequirement: Reachability questions need resolved references; duplicating traversal per capability yields inconsistent answers.

decisions.a1Note: DOWNGRADED: 3/3 have reference/resolution themes but not 3/3 forced single graph product. Rule: 1-of-3 is not corroborated; here partial multi-set → PREFERRED necessity.

decisions.title: Local-first offline distribution; hosted not on critical path
decisions.evidence: a:D46,D61 b:D22,D24,D25 c:D29 — all three

justificationTest.statedRequirement: Distribution, safety and portability support local offline use; none force a unique packaging shape.

decisions.title: Untrusted analysis logic must not hold ambient full authority
decisions.evidence: a:D51,D55 b:D26,D27 c:D23,D24 — all three

justificationTest.statedRequirement: Third-party analysis logic running with full developer-machine authority is unacceptable for a trusted gate.

decisions.title: Effectful Probe/simulation as a first-class analysis product
decisions.evidence: 0/3 propose executing the analyzed program or a simulation product; external toolchains appear as optional extractors, not Probe

justificationTest.statedRequirement: No stated product requirement forces executing the analyzed program. Effectful simulation is not implied by offline deterministic static analysis.

decisions.a1Note: Ratify REMOVED from greenfield architecture spine; may reappear as product if coordinator scopes sim. Not migration cost.

decisions.title: Distinguishable exit/termination classes for CI
decisions.evidence: a:D57,D58 b:D29 c:D25 — all three (A3 said only a)

justificationTest.statedRequirement: CI acts on exit status; conflating policy failure with tool failure makes wrong action invisible.

decisions.a1Note: Upgrade from CORROBORATED-WEAK: b and c both distinguish exit classes.

decisions.title: Baseline / accepted-debt mechanism for adoption with backlog
decisions.evidence: a:D36-D42 b:D16-D19 c:D12-D15 — all three

justificationTest.statedRequirement: Teams adopt with existing violations; gating on the entire backlog is unusable.

decisions.title: Lifetime-neutral core; one-shot and optional resident host
decisions.evidence: a:D46,D47 b:D23 c:D18 — all three address dual lifetime; incumbent R-1 REOPENED on deployment, not on neutrality of core

justificationTest.statedRequirement: Agent loops benefit from warm state; CI requires no residency. Both workloads are in scope of a local analysis CLI.

decisions.a1Note: Content match on dual-lifetime architecture. Incumbent REOPENED applies to ship/autostart/per-project (EC-2), not to denying core neutrality. A3 used incumbentForcing=REOPENED (invalid forcing enum); corrected to PREFERRED for deployment openness while corroborating dual-path design.

decisions.title: Retention/privacy: tool-created copies of user source are a first-class liability
decisions.evidence: a:D28,D61 c:D02,D03,D11 — b thinner but D12 portable artifacts; privacy explicit a+c, b via local trust boundary

justificationTest.statedRequirement: The tool reads proprietary source; what it retains is a liability it created on the user's behalf.

decisions.forcingRequirement: The tool creates user-derived copies; that is a liability requiring minimisation, disclosure, and control — statable without the codebase.
decisions.a1Note: Amended per B-ADJ-05: privacy-centered liability not clean-sheet MATCH.

decisions.title: Resolved configuration participates in analysis identity
decisions.evidence: a:D01,D20 b:D6,D14 c:D04,D17 — all three

justificationTest.statedRequirement: A verdict that changes with unexplained configuration is unauditable.

decisions.title: Deep/semantic analysis capability for some languages
decisions.evidence: A3 class ONLY-INCUMBENT is FALSE: a:D04,D52,D68 b:D31,D32 c:D07,D27 all address deep/tiered/semantic capability. Reclassified MATCH.
decisions.a1Note: Amended per B-ADJ-03: product languages/depth out of frozen Scope.

decisions.title: Public versioned contracts for machine consumers
decisions.evidence: a:D32 b:D15 c:D09 — present; exact contract set is preferred shape

justificationTest.statedRequirement: External consumers hold artifacts shaped by these contracts and cannot negotiate silently.

decisions.a1Note: Keep DOWNGRADED: versioned machine output is forced; the incumbent's full contract surface is not uniquely forced.

decisions.title: System neutralises environment inputs (locale, TZ, entropy, paths)
decisions.evidence: a:D31 FORCED; c:D03 hermetic clock/random/ambient; b weaker. Incumbent treats environment identity as user precondition more than system obligation.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: A result must be reproducible; an unenumerated environment input silently breaks reproducibility with no signal.

decisions.a1Note: Ratify ADOPT as architecture obligation (system discharges neutralisation). Not product-out-of-scope.

decisions.title: Bounded rule computational class (e.g. stratified fixpoint)
decisions.evidence: a:D13 only; b/c do not fix a class. Incumbent deferred.

justificationTest.statedRequirement: Rule surfaces must eventually be budgetable, but selecting a day-one computational class without a measured schema is not forced; deferral freezes fewer contracts.

decisions.a1Note: Amended per B-ADJ-04: DIVERGE with pre-clean-sheet rejection of day-one Datalog.
